title: LemonSMP Dependencies
description: Modpack for mods to use on my private server. Mods include mostly optimization, QoL, and tweaks to enhance the Vanilla Minecraft Experience. Only reason this is public is for ease of install for anyone I invite on my private server.
body:
Modpack for mods to use on my private server. Only reason this is public is for ease of install for anyone I invite on my private server; this page is really only intended for ease of install with Prism Launcher.

Forked from the **Simply Optimized** Modpack by **HyperSoop** - https://modrinth.com/modpack/sop

---

**MODPACK FUNCTIONS**

This modpack seeks to optimize performance for Vanilla Minecraft (specifically, 1.18.2, as this is the version of Minecraft my server runs on), while also adding a few quality of life features while still keeping the "vanilla experience" in-tact. Expect greater in-game performance as well as a few handy tweaks that doesn't take too much away from the base vanilla game experience.

A few things you can expect from this modpack are:
- Increased in-game performance
- Higher FPS
    - Greater viewing distance (specifically on servers)
    - Better performance monitors (changed the F3 menu, ability to see a persistent FPS counter in-game, etc.)
    - Reduced telemetry to Mojang
- Quality of Life
    - Proximity Voice Chat
    - Essential Mod (gives you the "Play Together" stuff from Bedrock + [much more](https://essential.gg))
    - Optifine Capes
    - Boats able to climb blocks (easier to transport mobs in boats)
    - Litematica (allows you to see schematics for builds in-game + [much more](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/litematica))

---

Mods used *from CurseForge*:
- **MiniHUD** By **masady** - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/minihud
- **OF Capes** By **Dragonostic** - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/of-capes
- **Smooth Boot (Fabric)** By **UltimateBoomer** - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/smooth-boot
- **MaLiLib** By **masady** - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/malilib
- **FPS Monitor** By **EwyBoy** - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/fps-monitor
- **Litematica** By **masady** - https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/litematica

*Modrinth mods are are already automatically accredited to their respective authors by Modrinth.

---

**I would continually check for updates with these sets of mods.**
